cond_0100.intro: The Lead Financial Analyst role provides an opportunity to join the Payments industry and learn both sides of the P&L, embrace technology, and make a direct impact on business results. The role is within the PULSE Line of Business Finance Organization and will report to the Sr. Manager, PULSE FP&A. The primary responsibilities of this position will be planning for PULSE Revenue and Volume, and reporting and analysis on the full PULSE P&L. This role would work closely with business partners to provide finance leadership, accurate forecasts, and insightful analysis to drive positive business results.
cond_0100.responsibilities:
Provide financial and business analysis support. Actively manage and escalate risk and customer-impacting issues within the day-to-day role to management.
Develop profitability analyses and projections for marketing and customer segments. Analyze customer behaviors and product profitability trends to understand financial implications and influence actions. Develop and enhance financial models. Improve forecasting accuracy and drive business insights. Incorporates the latest technology into work and drives technology innovation in the Finance area. Leverages diverse sources of data ([Product name masked], Essbase, Jaspersoft, Tableau, Excel etc.) to assess financial performance and assumptions for the forecast and to drive greater understanding of the business. Provide management with strategic advice and financial analyses for investment decisions, pricing changes, and channel and segment expansions. Prepares monthly financial presentations and analysis for leadership, effectively communicating financial results and performance against financial forecasts and yearly plans. Perform competitive analyses to drive strategic insights and actions. Provide ad-hoc financial analysis for area business leadership as requested to support business decisions. Translate business opportunities and issues into financial analyses. Develop business cases with recommendations to management. Collaborates with business partners to develop monthly financial forecasts which will drive appropriate and timely decision making. Analyzes financial performance and provides management and cross-functional teams to drive strategic investment decisions.

The role is within the [Company name masked] Line of Business Finance Organization and will report to the Sr. Manager, FP&A. The primary responsibilities of this position will be planning for Revenue and Volume, and reporting and analysis on the full P&L. This role would work closely with business partners to provide finance leadership, accurate forecasts, and insightful analysis to drive positive business results.
cond_0631.responsibilities:
Provide financial and business analysis support. Actively manage and escalate risk and customer-impacting issues within the day-to-day role to management.
Develop profitability analyses and projections for marketing and customer segments. Analyze customer behaviors and product profitability trends to understand financial implications and influence actions. Develop and enhance financial models. Improve forecasting accuracy and drive business insights. Incorporates the latest technology into work and drives technology innovation in the Finance area. Leverages diverse sources of data ([Product name masked], Essbase, Jaspersoft, Tableau, Excel etc.) to assess financial performance and assumptions for the forecast and to drive greater understanding of the business. Provide management with strategic advice and financial analyses for investment decisions, pricing changes, and channel and segment expansions. Prepares monthly financial presentations and analysis for leadership, effectively communicating financial results and performance against financial forecasts and yearly plans. Perform competitive analyses to drive strategic insights and actions. Provide ad-hoc financial analysis for area business leadership as requested to support business decisions. Translate business opportunities and issues into financial analyses. Develop business cases with recommendations to management. Collaborates with business partners to develop monthly financial forecasts which will drive appropriate and timely decision making. Analyzes financial performance and provides management and cross-functional teams to drive strategic investment decisions.
cond_0631.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or related field
2+ Years of experience in financial services, consulting, investment banking, or related field
Relevant financial planning & analysis experience
Critical thinking
Comfort with technology
Preferred Requirements
[Product name masked], SmartView experience
Master's degree in finance, business, or related field
4+ Years of experience in financial services, consulting, investment banking, or related field
